covers: Friday 13 November 2026 US close, the weekend and early Asian trade on Monday 16 November
headline: Wall Street ends a 2.5% up week despite Friday's chip selloff; rand near R16.95/$ and gold below $3,900 into an SA CPI and SARB week
summary: The S&P 500 closed Friday at 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq at 25,136.27, about 2.5% and 2.3% higher on the week, even after AMD fell 8.8%, Broadcom 4.8% and Nvidia 2.0% on the day; the US 10-year yield ended the week at 5.15%, up from 4.86% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026). The JSE All Share closed Friday at 112,387.86 and the Top 40 at 104,486.62, both slightly lower on the week, and the rand traded at R16.95/$ early on Monday from R16.76/$ at Friday's close (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 13-16 Nov 2026). In early trade gold was at $3,868.10 (-0.5%), Brent at $94.84 (-1.0%) and copper 1.0% lower; this week brings Nvidia's results, SA October CPI on 18 November and the SARB rate decision on 19 November (LRC Market Dashboard, 15-16 Nov 2026).

items.title: S&P 500 closes the week at 7,561.67 (+2.5% on the week), Nasdaq at 25,136.27 (+2.3%)
items.summary: Both indices ended Friday off their weekly highs after a chip-led selloff, but still held most of the week's gain: the S&P 500 rose from 7,376.86 on 6 November and the Nasdaq from 24,579.43.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC daily closes), 6 and 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Chip stocks close Friday lower: AMD -8.8%, Cisco -6.2%, Broadcom -4.8%, Nvidia -2.0%
items.summary: Losses narrowed slightly into the close from the afternoon (AMD had been down 10.5% at 20:25 SAST). Apple (+0.4%) and Microsoft (+0.2%) were steady.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance AMD, CSCO, AVGO, NVDA, AAPL, MSFT), close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year Treasury yield ends the week at 5.15%, up from 4.86%
items.summary: A rise of about 0.3 percentage points in a week, after hotter US inflation data; higher US yields tend to weigh on emerging-market currencies such as the rand.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 6 and 13 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE ends the week slightly lower: All Share 112,387.86, Top 40 104,486.62
items.summary: The All Share slipped 0.3% on the week from 112,739.40 and the Top 40 0.2% from 104,714.00. Friday's laggards included SPAR (-4.4%), Nedbank (-2.7%) and Standard Bank (-2.1%).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 6 and 13 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance SPP.JO, NED.JO, SBK.JO), 13 Nov 2026 17:00-17:09 SAST

items.title: Big week for SA data: October CPI on 18 November, SARB rate decision on 19 November
items.summary: Repo is 7.25% after September's hike; September CPI was 4.5% and core 4.0%. The SA 10-year bond yield ended last week at 8.73%, its highest this month.
items.source: LRC Macro Desk (Stats SA, SARB), 13 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard (Trading Economics SA 10Y), 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Rand at R16.95/$ early Monday, from R16.76/$ at Friday's close; R18.68/€, R22.38/£
items.summary: The rand is about 1.1% weaker against the dollar since Friday's close as the dollar stays firm on higher US yields.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ZAR=X, EURZAR=X, GBPZAR=X), 13 and 16 Nov 2026 05:51 SAST

items.title: Gold $3,868.10 (-0.5%), platinum $1,474.90 (-0.9%), copper $13,272/t (-1.0%) in early trade
items.summary: Metals extend last week's decline; gold is below $3,900 after a 4.6% weekly fall.
